subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should the remaining durable-approval work be extracted onto current main, or should this broad conflicted aggregate be reconciled and reviewed as one landing unit?
rationale: The mobile slice is already on main and has evolved independently, while the remaining plugin and session changes affect compatibility, state, and execution authorization; repository evidence cannot determine the preferred landing shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extract unique remainder
options.body: Keep current-main native code and transplant only the missing gateway replay, fail-closed gate, documentation, and necessary test changes.

options.title: Reconcile full aggregate
options.body: Resolve every conflict and repeat complete native, protocol, session, plugin, compatibility, and security review on the resulting head.

options.title: Pause the landing
options.body: Hold or replace this PR until the remaining work can be expressed as a smaller canonical change with exact-head proof.

recommendation.title: Extract unique remainder
recommendation.body: Keep current-main native code and transplant only the missing gateway replay, fail-closed gate, documentation, and necessary test changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history shows the strongest cross-surface context for the approval architecture, compatibility intent, and stacked landing sequence.
